_comment: Sample merged-pull-request metadata for an offline changelog dry run (issue #289). Shaped like the GitHub REST API so the same normaliser handles it. Used by scripts/changelog/dry-run.test.ts and safe to run by hand: npx tsx scripts/generate-changelog.ts --from scripts/changelog/fixtures/sample-pull-requests.json --version 1.4.0

pull_requests.title: feat(api): watch anchor deposit transactions
pull_requests.body: Adds an anchor watcher worker and its alert rule.

pull_requests.title: fix(web): keep the dashboard live when the socket drops
pull_requests.body: Reconnects with backoff instead of showing a stale table.

pull_requests.title: feat(api)!: require the X-Signature header on every webhook
pull_requests.body: BREAKING CHANGE: unsigned webhook requests are now rejected with 401.

pull_requests.title: perf(api): batch soroban topic index reads
pull_requests.body: One query per page instead of one per event.

pull_requests.title: docs: document the delivery lifecycle states
refactor(api): split the watcher supervisor
pull_requests.body: No behaviour change; smaller modules and clearer tests.
